status: PROVISIONAL -- the founder confirms this wording. Accepted as designed by R-2026-09-24-97 (the PR 3.4b-app C design report, section 4.3).
comment: Words ONLY the admin app shows, kept out of the public and ward tables so neither bundle carries them. `codes` maps every refusal the eight operator_* functions (and app.assert_operator / app.operator_session) can RAISE to a fixed sentence; INVALID_ARGUMENT is keyed with its DETAIL, the parameter the server refused, as `INVALID_ARGUMENT:<param>`. `constraints` maps every CHECK constraint on app.facility, app.facility_contact and app.facility_agreement to a sentence, because a 23514 is the only signal a bad latitude, longitude, phone or blank name gives (020 and 021 do not validate those fields themselves). `not_null` maps each column an operator function writes that has no default. tests/compliance/admin_render.test.ts holds `codes` and `constraints` to the migrations in both directions, and tests/db/admin_calls_live.test.ts holds `constraints` and `not_null` to the live catalogue. Server text is never shown: an unknown key gets `fixed.UNRECOGNISED`.

codes.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Signed out. Ask for a new sign-in link.
codes.NOT_AN_OPERATOR: This sign-in is not the operator's. Ward staff use app.openbed.ng.
codes.ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED: This operator account is switched off.
codes.SESSION_ID_IS_ACCOUNT_ID: Signed out. Ask for a new sign-in link.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_id: This page sent a facility reference the server could not read. Reload the page.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_facility_id: This page sent a facility reference the server could not read. Reload the page.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_category: Choose a ward category from the list.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_offering: Say whether this ward offers the service. It is never assumed.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_full_name: The contact's full name and job title are both needed.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_job_title: The contact's full name and job title are both needed.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_accepted_on: Enter the date the agreement was accepted.
codes.INVALID_ARGUMENT:p_signatory_role: The signatory's role is too long: 64 characters at most.
codes.NO_SUCH_FACILITY: This facility no longer exists. Reload the page.
codes.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: A facility was already created from this form with other details. Reload to see it.
codes.VERSION_CONFLICT: This facility changed since you opened it. It has been reloaded, and your changes were not saved.
codes.FACILITY_INACTIVE: This facility is switched off, so it cannot be listed.
codes.AGREEMENT_WITHDRAWN: The agreement was withdrawn. A facility cannot be listed on a withdrawn agreement.
codes.NO_CATEGORY: Add at least one ward category before listing.
codes.CATEGORY_EXISTS_WITH_OTHER_OFFERING: This category already exists with a different offering. It is not changed from here.
codes.NO_CONTACT_CHANNEL: Give an email address or a mobile number.
codes.MOBILE_NOT_E164: That mobile number is not in international form (+234...). Check the preview.
codes.MOBILE_REQUIRES_SMS_OPT_IN: A mobile number is kept only with SMS opt-in ticked. Tick it only if the contact agreed.
codes.AGREEMENT_VERSION_NOT_A_LABEL: The agreement version must be a short label, such as v1 or 2026-09.
codes.AGREEMENT_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The acceptance date cannot be after today in Lagos.
codes.AGREEMENT_ALREADY_RECORDED: An agreement is already recorded for this facility. A new one needs the founder's withdrawal steps first.

constraints.facility_lat_in_nigeria: Latitude must be between 4.0 and 14.0. Check that latitude and longitude are not swapped.
constraints.facility_lng_in_nigeria: Longitude must be between 2.5 and 15.0. Check that latitude and longitude are not swapped.
constraints.facility_phone_is_e164: The public phone is not in international form (+234...). Check the preview.
constraints.facility_contact_has_a_channel: Give an email address or a mobile number.
constraints.facility_contact_mobile_is_e164: That mobile number is not in international form (+234...). Check the preview.
constraints.facility_contact_sms_requires_optin: A mobile number is kept only with SMS opt-in ticked. Tick it only if the contact agreed.
constraints.facility_agreement_version_is_a_label: The agreement version must be a short label, such as v1 or 2026-09.
constraints.facility_agreement_signatory_role_is_sho: The signatory's role is too long: 64 characters at most.
constraints.facility_agreement_withdrawn_after_accep: A withdrawal date cannot be before the acceptance date.

not_null.facility.name: The facility needs a name.
not_null.facility.public_phone_e164: The facility needs a public phone number.
not_null.facility_contact.full_name: The contact's full name and job title are both needed.
not_null.facility_contact.job_title: The contact's full name and job title are both needed.
not_null.facility_agreement.accepted_on: Enter the date the agreement was accepted.
not_null.facility_agreement.version: The agreement version must be a short label, such as v1 or 2026-09.

fixed.UNRECOGNISED: The server refused this, for a reason this page does not recognise. Nothing was changed. Reload and try again.
fixed.UNREACHABLE: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and reload.
fixed.WORKER_REFUSED: The gateway does not allow this call yet. The Worker needs its redeploy (H5).
fixed.FUNCTION_MISSING: This operator function is not on the server yet: a migration has not been applied.
fixed.EDIT_DROPPED: The connection dropped. This is what is saved now. Check it before editing again.

screens.TITLE: OpenBed operator
screens.REQUEST_ANSWERED: If this address is the operator's, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it on this same device and browser.
screens.REQUEST_UNREACHABLE: The sign-in request could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
screens.ACCESS_ORDER: Open this page and pass the Cloudflare check before you ask for a link. Open the link on this same device and browser.
screens.BAD_LINK: It may have been used already, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
screens.STOP_HEADING: This page is for the operator
screens.WITHDRAWN_WARNING: The agreement is withdrawn. Finish the withdrawal steps in the runbook.
screens.SMS_OPT_IN_NOTE: Tick only if the contact has agreed to receive SMS from OpenBed. Keep the evidence with the agreement papers. The first opt-in time is kept.
screens.CANNOT_LIST_UNTIL: Listing needs: a contact, a recorded agreement and at least one ward category.
screens.PHONE_CHANGE_CONFIRM: This is the number the public page shows for an emergency call. Nothing is saved until you confirm the change.
